data: Is the red line labeled 'Exponential' consistently higher than the green line labeled 'Power law' in the bottom plot?

The red line labeled 'Exponential' is not consistently higher than the green line labeled 'Power law' in the bottom plot. The red line drops sharply at lower hypernym counts, while the green line labeled 'Power law' remains relatively flat and higher compared to the red line until approximately the same point where both lines intersect. After this intersection point, the red line labeled 'Exponential' becomes lower than the green line labeled 'Power law'.
